command: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . (Feature Mixer harness)

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V1CoreLoop.test_create_and_read_order
tests.expected: a new order is pending with its amount and no charge

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V1CoreLoop.test_create_order_validates_input
tests.expected: bad customer or amount and unknown ids are rejected and nothing is stored

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V1CoreLoop.test_default_store_and_store_flag
tests.expected: without a store the app makes its own, whose fail_next_write works the same

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V1CoreLoop.test_failed_commit_after_charge_is_recovered_without_second_charge
tests.expected: when the write after the charge fails, the order stays pending and the retry reuses the charge

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V1CoreLoop.test_failed_write_on_create_creates_nothing
tests.expected: StoreError and no order

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V1CoreLoop.test_failed_write_on_pay_leaves_order_unchanged
tests.expected: StoreError, order unchanged, gateway not called; the retry charges once

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V1CoreLoop.test_invalid_transitions_are_refused
tests.expected: cancelled and refunded orders cannot be paid; nothing is charged

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V1CoreLoop.test_key_is_required_and_bound_to_one_order
tests.expected: no key is refused; a key used for one order cannot pay another

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V1CoreLoop.test_ledger_is_a_copy_in_order
tests.expected: entries in order, one per money movement; editing the result changes nothing

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V1CoreLoop.test_paid_order_with_new_key_is_not_charged_again
tests.expected: a paid order is never charged again, whatever key is sent

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V1CoreLoop.test_pay_marks_order_paid
tests.expected: one charge, order paid with the gateway's charge id, one ledger charge

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V1CoreLoop.test_retry_with_same_key_charges_once
tests.expected: paying again with the same key makes no second charge

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V1CoreLoop.test_timeout_after_success_charges_once_and_order_is_paid
tests.expected: a lost response is recovered with the same key: one charge, order paid with its id

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V1CoreLoop.test_timeout_then_retry_with_new_key_still_charges_once
tests.expected: if the outcome stays unknown, a retry with any key reuses the first key

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V2Webhooks.test_failed_write_on_webhook_leaves_order_unchanged
tests.expected: StoreError, order unchanged and event not recorded; redelivery applies it once

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V2Webhooks.test_late_charge_on_cancelled_order_is_refunded_once
tests.expected: money arriving for a cancelled order is refunded once

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V2Webhooks.test_redelivered_webhook_is_applied_once
tests.expected: charge.succeeded delivered three times pays once with one ledger charge

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V2Webhooks.test_refund_webhook_applied_once
tests.expected: charge.refunded delivered twice gives one refund entry and status refunded

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V2Webhooks.test_unknown_events_are_ignored
tests.expected: unknown types and unknown orders change nothing; a refund event never pays

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V2Webhooks.test_webhook_after_pay_adds_nothing
tests.expected: the gateway's confirmation of a charge the app recorded changes nothing

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V3Cancel.test_cancel_paid_order_refunds_exactly_once
tests.expected: one gateway refund, status refunded, one ledger refund, even when cancelled twice

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V3Cancel.test_cancel_pending_order
tests.expected: a pending order is cancelled with no refund; cancelling again changes nothing

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V3Cancel.test_failed_write_on_cancel_leaves_order_unchanged
tests.expected: StoreError, order still paid, no refund sent; the retry refunds once

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V3Cancel.test_journey_pay_webhook_cancel_ledger
tests.expected: create, pay with a retry after a timeout, duplicate webhook, cancel twice: one charge and one refund everywhere

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V4Renewals.test_journey_renewal_then_payment
tests.expected: a renewal's order is paid once even if the renewal and the payment are retried

tests.name: tests.test_billing.V4Renewals.test_renewing_same_period_creates_one_order
tests.expected: one order per subscription per period; a new period creates a new order
